title: Norton source and load

value_provenance.explanation: All numbers newly declared. Keep case as required current-source feature target; never substitute an equivalent voltage-source network.
value_provenance.source_component_names: Reference symbolic labels are retained where practical; U1 and ordinal passive names are our identifiers.
value_provenance.source_waveform: Assigned 1 kHz sine stimulus for native AC. For DC/step checks use an MCP edit_values copy with the same source value and waveform kind dc.

limitations: No original schematic pixels or original numerical solver outputs are bundled.
Source images contain textbook-derived drawings; image redistribution clearance is unestablished.
Placement coordinates are logical hand transcriptions on a 20-unit grid, not extracted original pixel coordinates.
Saved/native source-current sign must be verified independently; physical current directions below define the oracle.
Current source I uses nodes=[from,to], positive first to second; ground-to-output polarity was verified by native output voltage. Physical direction and exported current signs are distinct.
Reference omits an explicit ground glyph; an analysis ground is added at its lower common return.

expected.provenance: Independent analytical expectations for the declared fixture; not FASTMEAN output and not original textbook answer data.
expected.frequency_sampling: Use the spec frequency range with logarithmic spacing; insert analytic checkpoints explicitly if they are absent from the sampled grid.

transient.comment: Purely resistive; compare after source rise time.
transient.source_preparation: MCP edit_values: preserve source amplitude value and set waveform={kind:dc} on a new copy.

visual_goals.reference_description: Three parallel vertical branches between upper and lower rails: source left, Rs central, RL right. Load-current arrow DOWNWARD. Add one analysis ground on lower return because reference has no ground glyph.
hard_gates: No accidental junctions, disconnected terminals or diagonal routes.
Real wires join adjacent primitives; ports identify external measurement nodes only.
Match reference branch orientation and relative component order.
Review reference-guided and automatic variants separately.
visual_goals.reference_guided_status: Created through MCP and visually reviewed; see validation-report.json for numerical runs, geometry refreshes and remaining glyph differences.
visual_goals.automatic_status: Created through MCP and visually reviewed. No per-case coordinates; rail/local ground style is retained. Arrangement differences are documented in validation-report.json.
